scheme_name: Free Coaching Scheme for SC and OBC Students
other_conditions: Must belong to Scheduled Caste or Other Backward Class.
Total annual family income must be ≤ ₹8,00,000.
For exams requiring class‑12 qualification, the candidate must have passed class 12 or be studying in class 12 at the time of receiving the benefit.

For exams requiring undergraduate qualification, the candidate must have completed the undergraduate course or be in the final year of the undergraduate programme at the time of receiving the benefit.
Benefits can be availed by a particular student not more than twice.
Applicant should not already be availing any other coaching scheme benefits.
Under each category, 30% of the slots are reserved for female candidates; if insufficient, male candidates from the same category may be considered.
benefits_summary: Monthly stipend of ₹4,000 for up to 12 months plus a ₹15,000 incentive for students clearing the mains stage of civil services examinations.
